runtimeStory: RBA Lead Viewer ingests real estate leads across multiple channels: Google Ads webhooks, Meta Lead Gen webhooks (with HMAC verification and Graph API resolution), Google Sheets bridge forwarding, and portal email parsers (99acres and Magicbricks). Inbound leads are validated, phone-formatted to E.164, mapped against campaign/property aliases, deduplicated by (source, external_lead_id), and written directly into Supabase Postgres via the service-role client. Internal staff and admins authenticate through Supabase SSR cookie auth to view the lead table, filter by source/campaign/timeline/status, search by text, and manage sales rep assignments. Sales reps authenticate with a role check and a 4-digit PIN to access a mobile-optimized card feed constrained by Postgres Row Level Security (RLS) to only their assigned leads, updating lead dispositions and follow-up timelines.
flow: Webhooks receive leads from Google Ads, Meta Ads (HMAC verified), Sheets, or portal emails (99acres/Magicbricks)
Payloads are parsed, normalized to uniform schema, phone numbers formatted to E.164, and campaign aliases resolved
Leads are upserted into Supabase public.leads with unique constraints, read-only field triggers, and service role key
Next.js middleware and Supabase SSR enforce session auth, role routing (admin/staff/sales), and PIN checks
Admin/staff view lead feed, inspect raw payloads in detail drawer, correct names, and assign to sales reps
Sales reps view RLS-filtered mobile cards, trigger calls/WhatsApp, submit dispositions, and log follow-up dates

app.purpose: Next.js 15 App Router handling user interface pages (Leads, Sales, Users, Settings) and server API/webhook routes.
keyAreas: src/app/leads — Interactive leads table with multi-criteria filters, search, quick actions, and detail drawer
src/app/sales — Mobile-optimized sales feed, PIN verification, disposition logging, and lead transfers
src/app/api/webhooks — Ingestion endpoints for Google Ads, Meta Graph API, Google Sheets, and Portal Emails
src/app/users — Admin-gated staff and sales rep user management (roles, sales PIN provisioning)
src/app/settings — Campaign, ad group, and property mapping configuration editor
app.runtime: Cloudflare Workers edge runtime via OpenNext adapter with Next.js SSR and Server Actions

components.purpose: Domain-specific and reusable UI components for lead presentation, quick drawers, and sales operations.
keyAreas: src/components/leads/AddLeadDrawer.tsx — Slide-over drawer for manual lead creation
src/components/sales/LeadCard.tsx — Mobile-friendly card showing contact details, property info, and actions
src/components/sales/DispositionSheet.tsx — Bottom sheet for recording call outcomes and next follow-up dates
src/components/sales/PINEntryScreen.tsx — 4-digit secure keypad for sales reps
src/components/sales/TransferModal.tsx — Modal to reassign leads between sales agents
components.runtime: Browser client (React 18 client components with Tailwind CSS styling)

lib.purpose: Core business logic: email parsers, payload normalizers, auth/RBAC policies, Supabase client factories, and formatters.
keyAreas: src/lib/leads/email-parser-* — Inbound email HTML/text parsers for 99acres and Magicbricks portals
src/lib/leads/normalize-* — Normalization pipelines for Google Ads and Meta Graph API payloads
src/lib/leads/google-ads-map.ts — In-memory caching and resolution for campaign/property mappings
src/lib/auth — RBAC helper functions, requireAdmin guard, user management, and PIN verification
src/lib/supabase — Typed Supabase SSR client factories (browser, server cookies, service-role admin)
lib.runtime: Node.js / Cloudflare Worker server-side execution with typed Supabase JS SDK

database.purpose: Supabase PostgreSQL database schema, migrations, Row Level Security (RLS) policies, and security definer RPCs.
keyAreas: 0001_init.sql — Base public.leads schema with unique constraint on (source, external_lead_id) and RLS
0004_allow_lead_name_edits.sql — Trigger function leads_protect_submitted_fields() defending immutable data
0005_add_property_mapping_type.sql — public.campaign_mappings table for alias resolutions
0006_add_lead_kpis_rpc.sql — get_lead_kpis() RPC computing totals, new, viewed, and source breakdown
0007_add_sales_assignment.sql — Lead assignment, disposition, status tracking columns
0008_sales_pin_rls.sql — Granular RLS policies restricting sales reps to assigned_to = auth.uid()
database.runtime: Supabase PostgreSQL database with PL/pgSQL triggers and pgcrypto

tests.purpose: Vitest test suite covering portal parsers, payload normalization, authorization guards, deduplication, and search filtering.
keyAreas: tests/email-parser-*.test.ts — Unit tests for 99acres and Magicbricks email payload extraction
tests/normalize-*.test.ts — Tests for Google Ads and Meta Graph API data normalization
tests/authorization.test.ts & tests/user-management.test.ts — Auth guards and RBAC role tests
tests/dedup.test.ts & tests/formatters.test.ts — Lead deduplication logic and phone/date formatting tests
tests/portal-email-webhook.test.ts — End-to-end webhook ingestion route testing
